answer: Operator Progress Ledger. Each agent identity draws compute through a shared operator account whose cumulative spend is escrowed like basalt under load: quota scales with total settled volume, not wallet count. Sybils from one operator share that ceiling, so N fake identities split one allowance instead of N. Enforcement freezes the operator's escrow, not the wallets, costing a fixed penalty per identity that scales like an ocean swell, exceeding any per-wallet gain. Honest operators recover through a lagoon of refundable overage after clean epochs.
